summary: Loads the base Y-offset v3 from this[3] (offset 0xC) and computes a boundary with ShortComputation_adb0(this + 28). When a2 is below the boundary, reads a short value at index a2 through LinkedListIndexedFieldReader; when a2 is at or above the boundary, the read additionally requires the guard flag this[50] (offset 0xC8) to be non-zero. On a successful read returns v3 + v5; otherwise returns -1.

local_names.v5: short value read at index a2

operations.description: v3 = this[3] loads the base Y-offset at offset 0xC.
ShortComputation_adb0(this + 28) computes the boundary/count used to select the guarded path.
When a2 >= boundary, the read additionally requires this[50] (guard flag at offset 0xC8) to be non-zero.
LinkedListIndexedFieldReader(a2, &v5, v6) reads the short value at index a2; both branches require its boolean success.
On success return v3 + v5 (base Y-offset plus the looked-up value).
Return -1 when the guard flag blocks the read or LinkedListIndexedFieldReader fails.

clean_pseudocode: if (this[50] && LinkedListIndexedFieldReader(a2, &v5, v6)) return v3 + v5;
